infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Star Map needs your location to show stars visible from your position.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: Star Map uses your location to calculate visible celestial objects.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Star Map uses motion sensors to track where you're pointing your device.
